piano.name: Meta Piano (upright)
piano.best: Every cue's backbone: the stalker's figure, the drips in the dark, her theme. Low single notes for dread, high soft ones for tenderness.

guitar.name: Meta Nylon Guitar
guitar.best: Nylon arpeggios: the ghost lover's lullaby, a warm memory, a quiet K-drama moment.

steel.name: Meta Steel Guitar
steel.best: Bright steel strings: a sunny K-drama day before it turns.

harp.name: Harp (VSCO-2)
harp.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
harp.best: Runs and glissandi: the slapstick fall's sweep, fairy-tale sweetness, a waltz's lilt.

glock.name: Glockenspiel (VSCO-2)
glock.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
glock.best: The music box and the twinkle; a far ping when she's watching.

marimba.name: Marimba (VSCO-2)
marimba.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
marimba.best: Woody, warm and cute: K-drama comedy, a light sneak.

xylo.name: Xylophone (VSCO-2)
xylo.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
xylo.best: Dry and comic: the bonk, the scurry, the cartoon fall.

bells.name: Tubular bells (VSCO-2)
bells.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
bells.best: Tubular bells: the funeral toll, the shrine, a bell too low and too long in the lullaby.

pizz.name: String section pizzicato (VSCO-2 cellos and violins)
pizz.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
pizz.best: Plucked section strings: the sneak, tiptoes, the comic chase, a heartbeat. The string sets swap who plays it.

strings.name: String section sustain (VSCO-2 cellos and violins)
strings.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
strings.best: The section's sustain: dread pedals, the romance swell, the rub that won't resolve. The string sets swap who plays it.

trem.name: String section tremolo (VSCO-2 cellos and violins)
trem.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
trem.best: Bowed tremolo: nerves, the hidden “she's watching” layer, the ponticello shimmer, the riser. The string sets swap who plays it.

flute.name: Flute (VSCO-2)
flute.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
flute.best: A clear line on top: the lullaby, the playground tune, a sweet theme.

flute_stac.name: Flute staccato (VSCO-2)
flute_stac.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
flute_stac.best: Short flute notes: tiptoes and giggles, the cute walk.

horn.name: French horn (VSCO-2)
horn.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
horn.best: One French horn: nobility turned ominous, the triumph, the sad sag of a falling note.

timpani.name: Timpani (VSCO-2)
timpani.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
timpani.best: Rolls and strikes: the riser, the shock's dun dun dun, the ritual.

drums.name: Drums and percussion (VSCO-2)
drums.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
drums.best: The percussion kit: taiko and bass drum for impacts, snare and claves for the playground clap, rolls, the gong, the anvil.

cbass_sus.name: Double bass sustain, no vibrato (VSCO-2)
cbass_sus.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
cbass_sus.best: The floor under everything, an octave below the cellos: dread, the basement, something big nearby. Sounds below C2 in the Full, Solo and Low sets; the Expanded cues use it alone.

viola_sus.name: Viola section sustain (VSCO-2)
viola_sus.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
viola_sus.best: The middle of the string section: thickens chords between the violins and the cellos. In the Full string set.

viola_trem.name: Viola section tremolo (VSCO-2)
viola_trem.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
viola_trem.best: A darker, rougher tremolo than the violins: nerves in the middle register. In the Full string set.

viola_pizz.name: Viola section pizzicato (VSCO-2)
viola_pizz.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
viola_pizz.best: A rounder pluck than the violins'. In the Full string set.

cello_sus.name: Cello section sustain (VSCO-2)
cello_sus.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
cello_sus.best: Warm and low with no violins over it: grief, the low bed of a romance, a slow dread. In the Low strings set.

cello_trem.name: Cello section tremolo (VSCO-2)
cello_trem.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
cello_trem.best: A low tremolo rumble under a chase or a reveal. In the Low strings set.

cello_pizz.name: Cello section pizzicato (VSCO-2)
cello_pizz.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
cello_pizz.best: Low plucked steps: a creeping walk, a heartbeat in pizzicato. In the Low strings set.

cbass_trem.name: Double bass tremolo (VSCO-2)
cbass_trem.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
cbass_trem.best: A growl you feel: under a riser, before the scare.

cbass_pizz.name: Double bass pizzicato (VSCO-2)
cbass_pizz.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
cbass_pizz.best: Deep plucks: the stalker's footsteps, a walking bass for the noir trumpet.

vln_solo.name: Solo violin (VSCO-2)
vln_solo.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
vln_solo.best: One player, exposed and close: a lament, her theme when she's alone, the lullaby sung on a string. In the Solo set.

vln_solo_trem.name: Solo violin tremolo (VSCO-2)
vln_solo_trem.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
vln_solo_trem.best: A thin, nervous shimmer: one string shaking in the dark. In the Solo set.

vln_solo_pizz.name: Solo violin pizzicato (VSCO-2)
vln_solo_pizz.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
vln_solo_pizz.best: A small, dry pluck: a music box's cousin, tiptoes. In the Solo set.

trombone.name: Trombone (VSCO-2, an old one)
trombone.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
trombone.best: Low brass chords: the funeral, the ritual, a dark chorale. Soft, it's a sigh; loud, a threat.

trombone_fall.name: Trombone falls (VSCO-2)
trombone_fall.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
trombone_fall.best: A note that drops away: the floor going out from under you, a sad joke's punchline. Stabs in Brass falls.

trombone_buzz.name: Trombone buzz (VSCO-2)
trombone_buzz.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
trombone_buzz.best: A rasping, buzzing note: something growls. Use it low and short.

tuba.name: Tuba (VSCO-2)
tuba.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
tuba.best: The lowest brass: a pedal under the trombones, heavy steps, a giant's tread.

trumpet_mute.name: Trumpet, harmon mute (VSCO-2)
trumpet_mute.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
trumpet_mute.best: A thin, nasal, far-away horn: noir, a lonely street at night, a memory of a jazz bar.

bassoon.name: Bassoon (VSCO-2)
bassoon.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
bassoon.best: Low reed, a little comic and a little sinister: the creeping line under a sneak, a sour chord.

clarinet.name: Clarinet (VSCO-2)
clarinet.credit: VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
clarinet.best: Its low register is hollow and cold: a lullaby on a dark landing, the ghost's breath.

glass.name: Wine glasses, rubbed (VCSL)
glass.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VCSL), CC0 1.0
glass.best: A glass-harmonica ghost tone, pure and unearthly: a presence in the room, a memory. Only four glasses (D#4 to D5): keep it high and slow.

psaltery.name: Bowed psaltery (VCSL)
psaltery.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VCSL), CC0 1.0
psaltery.best: A thin, wavering bowed tone like a singing saw: the haunted lullaby, a ghost humming. In the Eerie set over A#3 to F#5.

vibes_bowed.name: Vibraphone, bowed (VCSL)
vibes_bowed.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VCSL), CC0 1.0
vibes_bowed.best: A metal bar bowed: a pure, eerie swell with no attack. Behind you, the glass ghost, the moment she appears.

vibes.name: Vibraphone, soft mallets (VCSL)
vibes.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VCSL), CC0 1.0
vibes.best: Soft, round bell chords: a dreamy romance, a lounge gone quiet, a lullaby's chords.

kalimba.name: Kalimba (VCSL)
kalimba.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VCSL), CC0 1.0
kalimba.best: Plucked metal tongues, a little out of tune: a music box's older cousin, a child's toy, the lullaby.

harpsichord.name: Harpsichord, Flemish (VCSL)
harpsichord.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VCSL), CC0 1.0
harpsichord.best: The old house's instrument: a minuet in the empty ballroom, the mock-baroque strut gone sinister.

organ.name: Pipe organ, quiet (VCSL)
organ.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VCSL), CC0 1.0
organ.best: A quiet church organ: the funeral, the shrine, the wedding that shouldn't happen.

ocarina.name: Ocarina (VCSL)
ocarina.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VCSL), CC0 1.0
ocarina.best: A clay flute, breathy and childlike: the ghost child's tune, a game in the playground.

metals.name: Eerie metals and noises (VCSL, VSCO-2)
metals.credit: Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VCSL), CC0 1.0; VSCO-2 Community Edition by Versilian Studios (github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE), CC0 1.0
metals.best: The J-horror screech and its family: a bowed brake drum, a bowed or scraped cymbal, a gong scrape, the flexatone's wobble, a ratchet's croak, a siren, chains. Stings and textures, never a tune.
